title: Inverse-image restriction preserves coherent coefficient systems
statement: Let $I$ be a preorder, $D:I^{op}\to Sch$ a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $c$ any cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves with coefficient maps $\varphi_f$ satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition equations [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. Let $G:I\to Ab(c.pt_{Et})$ have specified isomorphisms $eG_i:G_i\cong c_i^*F_i$ and the canonical coefficient transition formula. Fix a scheme $X$, an index $i_0$, a morphism $g_0:D_{i_0}\to X$, and an open $W\subseteq X$. For $j\in J=I_{\ge i_0}$ take $W_j=(D(j\to i_0);g_0)^{-1}W$ and $W_L=(c_{i_0};g_0)^{-1}W$, with the restricted transitions and projections of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone]. Put $F'_j=F_j|_{W_j}$ and define $\varphi'_f$ by openSquareCoefficient. Put $G'=G|_J$ followed by inverse image along $W_L\to c.pt$. Define $eG'_j$ by inverse image of $eG_j$, inverse composition along $W_L\to c.pt\to D_j$, and composition along $W_L\to W_j\to D_j$. Then (1) $\varphi'$ satisfies the canonical identity equation, (2) $\varphi'$ satisfies the canonical composition equation, and (3) the maps of $G'$ satisfy the canonical transition formula for these specified $eG'_j$ and $\varphi'_f$. No limit, directedness, compactness, sheaf colimit, or cohomological continuity is assumed. In addition, for every cocone L of G and every tail stage j, its canonical restricted cohomology leg is the geometric pullback followed by H^0 of the inverse specified limit-coefficient isomorphism and restriction of L.ι_j.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), coherent systems, restricted to inverse-image opens; inverse-image composition coherence.

proof.text: Apply the generic diagram identity lemma to the tail inclusion on objects and the stage-open inclusions. The commuting square is Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι.

Use the proved vertical square-isomorphism pasting law to prove the generic openSquareCoefficient_composition formula. Cancel the mapped composition inverse/hom and apply naturality to the coefficient. Specialize to two successive tail transitions and apply hcomposition.

Apply openSquareCoefficient_composition to a stage transition followed by a cone projection, with coefficient eG_j.inv. Substitute hG after cancelling eG_i.inv/eG_i.hom. Identify both square coefficients with the inverses of tailOpenLimitIso using Functor.map_comp. Cancel tailOpenLimitIso_i.inv to obtain the restricted G-map equation.

Expand the canonical cohomology leg and the specified limit coefficient isomorphism. Functor.map_comp and the inverse-of-composite formula identify the restricted coefficient with eG-prime inverse followed by restriction of the original cocone leg. Apply H^0 without changing the geometric cohomology pullback.

theorem tailOpenRestrictedSystem_coherence
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id (op i)))).hom.app
        (F i) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj (op i))).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k),
      φ (f ≫ g) =
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op) (D.map f.op)
          (D.map (f ≫ g).op) (D.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g.op)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj i ≅
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), G.map f =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
          (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j))).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (i₀ : I) (g₀ : D.obj (op i₀) ⟶ X) (W : X.Opens) :
    let E := tailOpenDiagram D g₀ W
    let cE := tailOpenCone D c g₀ W
    let F' := tailOpenSheaf D g₀ W F
    let φ' := @tailOpenCoefficient _ _ D _ _ g₀ W F φ
    let R := upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ((c.π.app (op i₀) ≫ g₀) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι
    let G' := (tailOpenInclusion i₀ ⋙ G) ⋙ R
    let eG' := tailOpenLimitIso D c g₀ W F G eG
    (∀ j : Set.Ici i₀, φ' (𝟙 j) =
      (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (E.map_id (op j)))).hom.app
        (F' j) ≫ (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (E.obj (op j))).hom.app (F' j)) ∧
    (∀ (i j k : Set.Ici i₀) (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), φ' (f ≫ g) =
      (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (E.map g.op) (E.map f.op)
        (E.map (f ≫ g).op) (E.map_comp g.op f.op)).hom.app (F' i) ≫
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (E.map g.op)).map (φ' f) ≫ φ' g) ∧
    (∀ (i j : Set.Ici i₀) (f : i ⟶ j), G'.map f =
      (eG' i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cE.π.app (op j)) (E.map f.op)
          (cE.π.app (op i)) (cE.w f.op).symm).hom.app (F' i) ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (cE.π.app (op j))).map (φ' f) ≫ (eG' j).inv) ∧
    (∀ (L : Cocone G) (j : Set.Ici i₀),
      tailOpenCohomologyLeg D c g₀ W F G eG L j =
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap (cE.π.app (op j)) (F' j) 0) ≫
          AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (Sheaf.H.map ((eG' j).inv ≫
            R.map (L.ι.app j.val)) 0))
